title: Premium Candle Product Shot
tests: Resolves a vague premium-style brief through reasonable visual choices without unnecessary clarification.

judge.summary: A clean, softly lit candle product shot with an uncluttered neutral background looks polished, though the presentation is more understated than distinctly luxurious.

must_haves.item: A candle is clearly recognizable and is the dominant subject.
must_haves.why: The lit candle in a clear glass vessel occupies most of the frame.

must_haves.item: The candle and its container have clean, well-defined edges without obvious distortions.
must_haves.why: The glass rim, cylindrical sides, base, and wax surface have coherent shapes without obvious warping.

must_haves.item: The composition is uncluttered, with no distracting household objects.
must_haves.why: Only the candle appears against a plain background and surface.

must_haves.item: Controlled lighting and a coordinated background present the candle as a polished retail product.
must_haves.why: Soft directional lighting, restrained glass highlights, and a neutral gray setting create a cohesive retail presentation.
